assignment: Prepare a field director's recommendation for adding two stations to a regional network.
source: Existing stations are three downtown rooftops. Candidate V is a rural valley with mains power. Candidate H is an exposed highland with reliable solar power. Candidate R is another downtown roof with excellent connectivity. Comparison to a 20-year downtown series matters, but the new objective is regional coverage during heat events. Budget supports two new sites and a two-week portable overlap.

criteria.full: Selects exactly two candidates and explains how their exposures complement or duplicate the existing network.
criteria.partial: Picks sites mainly for convenience without addressing coverage.

criteria.full: Uses the portable overlap or other calibration comparison to relate new records to the downtown series.
criteria.partial: Claims that comparable instruments alone establish historical continuity.

criteria.full: Distinguishes site-specific temperatures from an area-wide mean and explains limits of spatial weighting or population exposure.
criteria.partial: Averages all five without considering their representation.

criteria.full: Assigns heat-event uptime and metadata checks with a condition for revisiting placement.
criteria.partial: Mentions maintenance without a measurable observation.
